Job Title : Assistant Quality Manager for Home Care Powder

Location : Cikarang Factory

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

The primary responsibility of the Site Assistant Quality Manager at the factory is to implement Unilever's specifications, standards, and quality management systems to ensure and control product quality starting from material (sourcing), production process, and until finished good meet the specification & standards

Main Responsibilities

• Implement Unilever's Quality Management System for quality assurance and control in the factory, verify compliance with Unilever's Quality Management System and standard
• Implement Unilever’s Quality Management system to assure quality assurance and control toward regulation in Indonesia
• Adhere to and enforce Unilever's Technology Standards and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) guidelines in the factory and continuous improvement in Quality assurance
• Apply control measures, inspections, and sampling plans according to requirements and risks, such as allergens, microbiological contamination, and chemical contamination.
• Conduct necessary tests to verify quality throughout the production process and adhere to Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) guidelines.
• Manage to perform with laboratory team for required tests to check the quality of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished good testing.
• Complete and maintain external certification and audits
• Review and analyze operational KPIs, data, and trends to maintain quality performance within specified ranges.
• Utilize, maintain, and calibrate relevant measurement instruments that relevant to Quality assurance and regulation compliances
• Ensure innovation processes and change management projects in the factory adhere to Unilever's quality standards during the feasibility and execution stages.

Requirements
Experience & Qualification

• University Degree in Engineering or Pharmacy. Supply chain qualifications (e.g., APICS) are an advantage
• Min 3-5 Years in Supply Chain operations (Quality)
• Laboratory compliance & Management experiences
• Quality assurance/engineer experience, SAP capability
• Understanding in statistical and digital will be beneficial

Skill

• Excellent Excel/Presentation skills and Analytical Skills
• Critical thinking, problem solving, and growth mindset
• Good Communication Skills and able to work in fast paced environment and manage timelines
• Strong stakeholder management skill
• Understanding statistical process control and digital will be beneficial
